note: SCRAPED, NOT SYNTHETIC. Real payer policy text retrieved via Bright Data (zone tally_fda) and cached at author time; nothing fetches at runtime. TRUNCATED CAPTURES, not verbatim quotations: both clause texts were cut by a fixed-length capture window - each ends mid-word and pulls in adjacent unrelated content (docs/PRODUCTION_GAP.md G-25). The captured characters themselves are untouched - no summarisation, no paraphrase, no spelling corrections, and the cuts are NOT edited to read better, because completing or trimming a capture would be authoring payer language. This file is SEPARATE from data/policies.json on purpose: policies.json drives the live demo and is validated by npm run verify, and a scraped document must not be able to break a working clinical path. It must not be promoted into the determination path until the excerpts are re-captured with source locators. Absence of a clause here is not evidence a payer lacks one.
